MODEL SHEET 1 — BASIC STANCES. White background, 3 rows x 3 columns, every figure the same scale on a faint floor line, small label under each figure. Fists held at the belt (chambered at the hips) in every figure so the legs are unobstructed.
Row 1 'NARANHI SEOGI (parallel ready stance)': feet parallel, one foot-width apart, legs straight. Columns: FRONT, SIDE, BACK.
Row 2 'MOA SEOGI (closed stance)': feet together, toes and heels touching. Columns: FRONT, SIDE, BACK.
Row 3 'AP SEOGI (walking stance)': one natural walking step, left foot forward, both legs straight, feet pointing forward, rear foot turned out slightly, weight even, hips square. Columns: FRONT, SIDE, BACK.
Both feet clearly visible in every view with heel, arch and toes. No ears. No other text, no logos.

Use the SAME character and the SAME drawing style as the reference image: realistic anatomical ink figure drawing, fine line, light cross-contour shading, faceless head with short hair, white dobok with black V-collar, black belt, bare feet, 7.5 heads tall.

MODEL SHEET 2 — AP KUBI (front stance), left foot forward. White background, four panels in a row, same scale, small label under each: FRONT, SIDE, BACK, and TOP-DOWN FOOTPRINT diagram.
Stance rules, follow exactly: length about one and a half shoulder widths, width one fist; FRONT KNEE BENT so the knee is directly over the toes and the shin is vertical; REAR LEG STRAIGHT (locked, no bend); rear heel flat on the floor; rear foot turned out about 30 degrees; front foot pointing straight forward; hips and chest square to the front; torso upright; weight about two-thirds on the front leg. Arms: right middle punch extended forward at solar-plexus height, left fist chambered at the hip.
The footprint panel shows both footprints from above with the stance length and width marked by thin lines. Feet clearly visible in every view. No ears. No other text, no logos.

Use the SAME character and the SAME drawing style as the reference image: realistic anatomical ink figure drawing, fine line, light cross-contour shading, faceless head with short hair, white dobok with black V-collar, black belt, bare feet, 7.5 heads tall.

MODEL SHEET 3 — DWIT KUBI (back stance), left foot forward. White background, four panels in a row, same scale, small label under each: FRONT (viewer stands where the front foot points), SIDE, BACK, and TOP-DOWN FOOTPRINT diagram.
Stance rules, follow exactly: feet form an L: the front (left) foot points forward, the rear (right) foot is turned 90 degrees out, and BOTH HEELS ARE ON ONE LINE; stance length about one and a half foot lengths; about 70 percent of the weight on the REAR leg, which is deeply bent with the REAR KNEE PUSHED OUT TO THE SIDE over the rear toes; front knee slightly bent, front foot light; HIPS AND CHEST TURNED SIDEWAYS, about 90 degrees from the front foot, so the torso is seen side-on when the front foot points at the viewer; head turned to look over the front foot. Arms: double knife-hand middle block (sonnal momtong makki): left knife hand forward at shoulder height, right knife hand palm-up in front of the solar plexus.
The footprint panel shows the L shape with the heel line marked. Feet clearly visible in every view. No ears. No other text, no logos.

MODEL SHEET 4 — BEOM SEOGI (tiger stance), left foot forward. White background, four panels in a row, same scale, small label under each: FRONT, SIDE, BACK, TOP-DOWN FOOTPRINT.
Stance rules: short stance, about one foot length between the feet; the FRONT FOOT rests lightly on the BALL of the foot with the heel raised; almost all weight on the REAR leg, which is bent, rear foot turned out about 30 degrees; both knees bent and drawn slightly inward; hips turned about 45 degrees; torso upright. Arms: right palm inside block (batangson momtong an makki) in front of the chest, left fist chambered at the hip.
Feet clearly visible in every view, showing the raised front heel. No ears. No other text, no logos.

Feet clearly visible in every view. No ears. No other text, no logos.
